page.h1: Best swimming headphones with built-in MP3 storage under $100 (2026)
page.desc: The MOJAWA Run Plus has 32 GB, IP68 and a battery Headphones Addict timed at 8 h 43 min. We compare it with the Jabees 7Seven, a refurbished Run Plus and H2O Audio's STREAM 3 PRO, priced on 2026-11-08.
page.answer: Short answer. The best swimming headphones with built-in MP3 storage under $100 are the MOJAWA Run Plus: 32 GB of built-in MP3 storage, IP68 to 2 m, and a battery Headphones Addict timed at 8 h 43 min at 50% volume, then recharged in 50 minutes.

page.after:
What the differences mean

  • Swims per charge. Run Plus: 8.72 h measured ÷ 0.75 h = 11 full 45-minute swims. Jabees 7Seven: 6 h claimed ÷ 0.75 h = 8. STREAM 3 PRO: 7 h claimed ÷ 0.75 h = 9.
  • Time on the charger. Run Plus: 8.72 h of play ÷ 0.83 h of charging = about 10 h of music per hour on the cable. 7Seven: 6 h ÷ 2 h = 3 h per hour.
  • Price. $99.99 − $59.99 = $40 between a new Run Plus and either the 7Seven or a refurbished Run Plus.
  • Depth. The Run Plus is rated to 2 m and the 7Seven to 1.5 m, so the Run Plus has 0.5 m more margin for pool dives.
  • Storage. 32 GB ÷ 8 GB = 4 times the music on the Run Plus or 7Seven compared with the STREAM 3 PRO or the 7Seven Air.
UseFits

Battery: who timed what

Built-in storage matters because Bluetooth stops at the water's surface. H2O Audio's own product page says "Bluetooth does NOT work underwater", so the music has to live on the headset. The figure that decides how often you charge is runtime, and only one model here has been put on a clock by a named tester:

  • MOJAWA Run Plus: Headphones Addict (Peter Susic, 2023-08-01) played music at 50% volume until the battery ran out at 8 h 43 min, then recharged it from 0 to 100% in 50 minutes. MOJAWA's own rating is 8 h at 75% volume. The review doesn't say whether the test ran in MP3 or Bluetooth mode. GamingTrend (Ron Burke) saw roughly 1 h from empty to full but repeated MOJAWA's runtime claim without testing it.
  • Jabees 7Seven: New Atlas (Bronwyn Thompson, 2025-10-19) writes that "we didn't track it exactly" against Jabees' 5 h Bluetooth / 6 h MP3 claim at 60% volume, and calls that claim "probably a stretch". The review puts a full charge at about 2 h.
  • H2O Audio STREAM 3 PRO: 7 h, H2O Audio's figure. FINIS Duo: up to 7 h and 4 GB according to FINIS's own manual. We couldn't confirm a current US price for the Duo on 2026-11-08, so it isn't in the table.

All of these players need music files you own, copied over from a computer. H2O Audio's STREAM DM page states that an Apple Music subscription doesn't let you download the files to its players. If you can spend more than $100, MOJAWA's Purra Swim is $169.99, has 32 GB and is rated for 15 h, which works out to 15 ÷ 0.75 = 20 swims per charge. {buy:mojawa-purra-swim-32gb-bone-conduction}

Not recommended

H2O Audio STREAM 3 PRO at "$99.99". On 2026-11-08 the $99.99 option on H2O Audio's store comes with no headphones and is sold out. Every version that includes SURGE headphones costs $129.00, which is $29 over the budget, and it holds 8 GB against 32 GB on the Run Plus. H2O's goggle-mounted SONAR was sold out in both bundles when checked the same day.

Jabees 7Seven Air, if you want the 32 GB 7Seven. Jabees sells it alongside the 7Seven for $49.99, but it has 8 GB of MP3 memory. Jabees also lists each magnetic charging cable as exclusive to its own model. Check that the name on the box is "7Seven", not "7Seven Air", before you pay.
